title: AWF Configuration
description: JSON/YAML configuration for awf CLI. CLI flags override config file values. See https://github.com/github/gh-aw-firewall for documentation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for IDE validation and autocomplete.

allowDomains.description: Domains that the agent is allowed to reach. Both the bare domain and all subdomains are permitted (e.g. "github.com" also allows "api.github.com").

blockDomains.description: Domains that are explicitly blocked, overriding allowDomains.

dnsServers.description: DNS servers to use inside the container. Defaults to Google DNS (8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4). Accepts IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

upstreamProxy.description: Upstream HTTP proxy URL (e.g. "http://proxy.corp.example.com:8080"). When set, the AWF Squid proxy forwards traffic through this proxy.

isolation.description: Experimental: enforce egress via Docker network topology (an internal network with no internet route plus a dual-homed Squid proxy) instead of host iptables. Requires no sudo/NET_ADMIN, so it works inside ARC/Kubernetes DinD runners. Not yet supported together with dnsOverHttps or enableHostAccess. Maps to the --network-isolation CLI flag.

verifySbxEgress.description: Fail before agent startup unless Docker sbx blocks a direct request made with all proxy environment variables removed. Intended for orchestrators that start the sbx daemon with DOCKER_SANDBOXES_PROXY chained to AWF Squid. Maps to --verify-sbx-egress.

topologyAttach.description: Names of externally-launched trusted containers (e.g. an MCP gateway or DIFC proxy) to attach to the internal topology network so the agent can reach them without granting them their own egress path. Requires network.isolation to be true. Maps to repeated --topology-attach CLI flags.

filesystem.description: Host filesystem write-boundary configuration for the agent sandbox.

allowWrite.description: Guest-visible absolute paths that may be writable. When present, existing writable host bind mounts are made read-only outside these paths. An empty array makes all non-internal host bind mounts read-only. Paths must exist and cannot use glob patterns. This option is supported by the Docker and gVisor compose runtimes and by the Cloud Hypervisor microVM runtime; it is rejected with the sbx runtime and with Docker-in-Docker agent execution.

apiProxy.description: API proxy sidecar configuration. The sidecar injects real API credentials so the agent never has direct access to them.

enabled.description: [DEPRECATED] The API proxy sidecar is always enabled; this field is ignored. Source credentials (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN, COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY) are always held exclusively in the sidecar and excluded from the agent environment. The negated CLI form --no-enable-api-proxy is rejected at runtime. See docs/awf-config-spec.md §9.3 for details.

caCert.description: Host path to an additional CA certificate for api-proxy upstream TLS verification. The file is bind-mounted read-only into the sidecar and exposed via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.

enableTokenSteering.description: Enable effective token budget steering. When true, the proxy injects budget-warning system messages at 80%, 90%, 95%, and 99% usage to nudge the agent to wrap up. Requires maxEffectiveTokens. Default: false.

anthropicAutoCache.description: Automatically apply Anthropic prompt-cache optimizations on /v1/messages requests.

anthropicCacheTailTtl.description: TTL for Anthropic cache tail optimization. Only applies when anthropicAutoCache is enabled. Allowed values: "5m" or "1h".

maxEffectiveTokens.description: Maximum cumulative effective tokens allowed for a run. When reached, the API proxy rejects subsequent requests with HTTP 403 and error type 'effective_tokens_limit_exceeded'. Tokens are weighted: input ×1, cache-read ×0.1, output ×4, reasoning ×4. See spec §10.

maxAiCredits.description: Maximum cumulative AI credits allowed for a run. When reached, the API proxy rejects subsequent requests with HTTP 403 and error type 'ai_credits_limit_exceeded'. AWF also enforces a non-overridable hard cap of 10,000 AI credits; values above 10,000 are effectively clamped.

defaultAiCreditsPricing.description: Fallback per-token pricing ($/1M tokens) for models not in the built-in pricing table. When maxAiCredits is active and a model is unrecognized, this rate is used. If not set, unrecognized models are rejected with HTTP 400 (type: unknown_model_ai_credits).

input.description: Input token price per 1M tokens in dollars.

output.description: Output token price per 1M tokens in dollars.

cachedInput.description: Cached input token price per 1M tokens. Defaults to input × 0.1 if omitted.

cacheWrite.description: Cache write token price per 1M tokens. Null means cache writes are free.

providers.description: Per-provider model pricing catalog overlays merged into the API proxy model pricing table for AI-credits accounting.

modelMultipliers.description: Per-model multipliers for effective token accounting. Each model's weighted tokens are multiplied by this value before accumulation. Unlisted models use defaultModelMultiplier when set, otherwise the highest configured multiplier. See spec §10.2.

defaultModelMultiplier.description: Default multiplier applied when a model is not present in modelMultipliers. When omitted, AWF uses the highest configured model multiplier as a conservative fallback.

maxModelMultiplierCap.description: Maximum allowed model multiplier. When set, the proxy resolves each incoming request's model against the configured modelMultipliers (and defaultModelMultiplier) and rejects any request whose resolved multiplier exceeds this cap with HTTP 400 and error type model_multiplier_cap_exceeded. This guards against unexpected pricing spikes from model routing changes.

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of LLM invocations allowed for a run. When reached, the API proxy rejects subsequent requests with HTTP 429 and error type 'max_runs_exceeded'. See spec §11.

maxRuns.description: Deprecated alias for maxTurns. Use maxTurns instead.

maxPermissionDenied.description: Maximum number of upstream permission-denied (401/403) responses allowed per run. When reached, the API proxy rejects all subsequent requests with HTTP 403 and error type 'permission_denied_limit_exceeded', stopping the run to avoid wasting tokens on misconfigured or missing API credentials. When unset, the guard is disabled.

maxCacheMisses.description: Maximum number of consecutive cache misses allowed per run. A miss is counted only for successful responses with non-zero input_tokens and zero cache_read_tokens. Responses with cache_read_tokens > 0 reset the streak. When reached, the API proxy rejects subsequent requests with HTTP 403 and error type 'max_cache_misses_exceeded'.

requestedModel.description: Expected model name for pre-startup validation. When set, the API proxy validates at startup that this model is available in at least one provider's model catalogue. Emits a clear diagnostic if the model is retired, restricted, or misspelled. Does not block startup.

modelFallback.description: Model fallback policy for unresolved model selections. Enabled by default as a safety net.

enabled.description: Enable or disable middle-power fallback when model resolution fails.

strategy.description: Fallback selection strategy. Currently only 'middle_power' is supported.

excludeEngines.description: List of engine/provider names for which middle-power fallback is suppressed. Use this to let specific providers handle model-unavailable errors natively instead of rewriting to a fallback model.

modelRouter.description: Model-router settings for Copilot-compatible BYOK upstreams.

providerType.description: Provider type hint for router-specific behavior (maps to COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE).

baseUrl.description: Router base URL for Copilot BYOK upstream traffic (maps to COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL).

targets.description: Override upstream API endpoints for each provider.

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot API target override and BYOK supplemental headers (basePath not supported).

vertex.description: Google Vertex AI API target override.

antigravity.description: Antigravity API target override (alias of Gemini runtime settings).

models.description: Model alias mapping. Keys are canonical model names; values are arrays of alternative names or patterns that should be rewritten to the canonical name.

allowedModels.description: Allowlist of permitted model names (glob patterns). When set, only models matching at least one pattern are permitted. Uses case-insensitive glob matching with * as a wildcard. Evaluated after disallowedModels — a model in the denylist is always rejected even if it matches the allowlist. Examples: ["*sonnet*", "*haiku*"].

disallowedModels.description: Denylist of prohibited model names (glob patterns). Models matching any pattern are rejected with HTTP 403 regardless of the allowedModels allowlist. Uses case-insensitive glob matching with * as a wildcard. Examples: ["*opus*", "gpt-5*"].

auth.description: Authentication configuration for the API proxy sidecar. Enables OIDC-based credential exchange (e.g., GitHub OIDC → Azure AD, AWS STS, GCP Workload Identity, or Anthropic Workload Identity Federation). See docs/awf-config-spec.md §9.5.

type.description: Authentication type. Currently only 'github-oidc' is supported. Maps to AWF_AUTH_TYPE.

provider.description: Cloud provider for OIDC token exchange. Determines which token exchange protocol is used. Maps to AWF_AUTH_PROVIDER.

oidcAudience.description: Audience claim for the GitHub OIDC token. Provider-specific defaults apply when omitted: Azure='api://AzureADTokenExchange', AWS='sts.amazonaws.com', GCP=workloadIdentityProvider value, Anthropic='https://api.anthropic.com'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_OIDC_AUDIENCE.

azureTenantId.description: Azure AD tenant ID for federated credential exchange. Required when provider is 'azure'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AZURE_TENANT_ID.

azureClientId.description: Azure AD application (client) ID for the federated credential. Required when provider is 'azure'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AZURE_CLIENT_ID.

azureScope.description: Azure token scope. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AZURE_SCOPE.

azureCloud.description: Azure cloud environment. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AZURE_CLOUD.

awsRoleArn.description: AWS IAM role ARN to assume via OIDC federation. Required when provider is 'aws'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AWS_ROLE_ARN.

awsRegion.description: AWS region for the Bedrock endpoint. Required when provider is 'aws'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AWS_REGION.

awsRoleSessionName.description: Session name for the AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity call. Maps to AWF_AUTH_AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME.

gcpWorkloadIdentityProvider.description: Full resource name of the GCP Workload Identity Provider (projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/POOL_ID/providers/PROVIDER_ID). Required when provider is 'gcp'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER.

gcpServiceAccount.description: GCP service account email to impersonate. When omitted, the federated token is used directly (requires direct resource access grants on the principal). Maps to AWF_AUTH_GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.

gcpScope.description: OAuth2 scope for GCP token. Maps to AWF_AUTH_GCP_SCOPE.

anthropicFederationRuleId.description: Anthropic federation rule ID (e.g. fdrl_...). Required when provider is 'anthropic'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID.

anthropicOrganizationId.description: Anthropic organization UUID. Required when provider is 'anthropic'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID.

anthropicServiceAccountId.description: Anthropic service account ID (e.g. svac_...). Required when provider is 'anthropic'. Maps to AWF_AUTH_ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID.

anthropicWorkspaceId.description: Anthropic workspace ID. Required when the federation rule covers multiple workspaces. Maps to AWF_AUTH_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID.

anthropicTokenUrl.description: Anthropic OAuth token exchange endpoint override. Non-sensitive config and maps to AWF_AUTH_ANTHROPIC_TOKEN_URL.

logging.description: API proxy diagnostic and model-alias logging configuration.

debugTokens.description: Enable detailed token and model-alias diagnostics. Writes MODEL_ALIAS_RESOLUTION_STEP, MODEL_ALIAS_REWRITE, and other diagnostic events to token-diag.jsonl. Maps to AWF_DEBUG_TOKENS=1.

tokenLogDir.description: Directory for token-usage.jsonl and token-diag.jsonl files. Must be /var/log/api-proxy (or a subdirectory) so logs are captured by AWF's bind mount.

diagnostics.description: Opt-in diagnostics for blocked LLM requests. Writes body-shape records to blocked-request-diag.jsonl when a guard hard-rails a request.

captureBlockedRequests.description: Enable capture of body-shape diagnostics for guard-blocked requests. 'summary' captures counts/sizes/hashes only (no content). 'redacted' adds first 200 chars per message. 'full' captures the entire body up to maxCapturedBytes. Maps to AWF_CAPTURE_BLOCKED_LLM_REQUESTS.

maxCapturedBytes.description: Maximum body bytes to include in a single 'full'-mode blocked-request-diag record. Maps to AWF_MAX_BLOCKED_CAPTURE_BYTES.

legacySecurity.description: Enable legacy security mode (sudo, host-access, iptables). When omitted or false, strict security is enforced (network-isolation + API proxy credential injection).

securityMode.description: [DEPRECATED] Use legacySecurity instead. Will be removed in a future release.

sslBump.description: Enable SSL bumping (TLS interception) in the Squid proxy. Requires a custom CA certificate.

enableDlp.description: Enable Data Loss Prevention (DLP) inspection of outbound traffic.

enableHostAccess.description: Mount the host filesystem (read-only for system paths, read-write for the workspace). Enabled by default; set to false to run without host filesystem access.

allowHostPorts.description: Host TCP ports the agent may connect to (e.g. local dev services). Accepts a single port string or an array of port strings.

allowHostServicePorts.description: Named service ports on the host that the agent may connect to. Accepts a single port string or an array of port strings.

caCert.description: Path to the CA certificate for DIFC proxy TLS verification.

memoryLimit.description: Docker memory limit for the agent container (e.g. "4g", "512m"). Uses Docker memory limit syntax.

agentTimeout.description: Maximum time (in minutes) the agent command is allowed to run.

enableDind.description: Expose the Docker socket inside the agent container so the agent can run docker commands. When combined with container.dockerHost (or the DOCKER_HOST environment variable), AWF uses that socket path for both AWF's own operations and the in-agent DOCKER_HOST. WARNING: allows the agent to bypass the AWF firewall via docker run.

workDir.description: Host path used as the AWF working directory for generated configs and logs. Defaults to a temporary directory.

containerWorkDir.description: Working directory inside the agent container.

imageRegistry.description: Container image registry to pull from. Defaults to "ghcr.io/github/gh-aw-firewall".

imageTag.description: Container image tag to use. Defaults to "latest".

skipPull.description: Skip pulling container images (use locally cached images).

buildLocal.description: Build container images from source instead of pulling from the registry.

agentImage.description: Override the agent container image (e.g. for a GitHub Actions parity image).

images.description: Closed manifest of digest-pinned infrastructure images keyed by image role (AWF v0.28.4+). Config-only. Every value must be a literal, registry-qualified reference containing both a tag and a SHA-256 digest. When present, AWF requires every image role needed by the enabled feature set, fails closed instead of falling back to the official registry, and cannot be combined with imageRegistry, imageTag, agentImage, buildLocal, runner.sysrootImage, dind.stagingImage, security.sslBump, or per-enclave image overrides.

tty.description: Allocate a pseudo-TTY for the agent container.

dockerHost.description: Docker daemon socket URI for AWF's own operations (e.g. "unix:///var/run/docker.sock" or "tcp://localhost:2375"). Auto-detected from the DOCKER_HOST environment variable when not set explicitly. When combined with container.enableDind, AWF also mounts that socket inside the agent and sets the agent's DOCKER_HOST to the same URI so in-agent docker commands use the correct daemon. On ARC/DinD runners with a loopback TCP daemon (tcp://localhost:* or tcp://127.0.0.1:*), AWF treats this as a DinD hint for warnings (for example, missing container.dockerHostPathPrefix), but does not auto-apply a path prefix.

dockerHostPathPrefix.description: Prefix bind-mount source paths so the Docker daemon can resolve runner filesystem paths. Required for ARC DinD sidecar runners where the runner and daemon have separate filesystems. Example: "/host". Kernel virtual filesystems (/dev, /sys, /proc) are automatically excluded from prefixing. When this points at a daemon-visible shared /tmp path, AWF also stages the invoking CLI binary plus /etc/passwd, /etc/group, and the generated chroot /etc/hosts there.

runnerToolCachePath.description: Host runner tool cache directory to mount read-only into chroot mode. When set, AWF checks this path first before environment-based auto-detection.

mounts.description: Custom volume mounts for the agent container. Format: "/host_path:/container_path[:ro|rw]" (both paths must be absolute). In chroot mode, container paths are automatically prefixed with /host.

containerRuntime.description: Container runtime for the agent container. "gvisor" runs the agent under gVisor's runsc runtime (OCI runtime, compose-based). "sbx" runs the agent inside a Docker sbx microVM with hypervisor isolation; infrastructure containers (squid-proxy, api-proxy) stay in Docker Compose on the host and the sbx proxy chains upstream through AWF's Squid for domain filtering. Only the agent uses the custom runtime; infrastructure containers always use the default runc runtime.

cloudHypervisor.description: Cloud Hypervisor v53.0 microVM preview configuration. Requires container.containerRuntime: "cloud-hypervisor" and previewEnabled to execute workloads; supported only on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu x86_64 KVM runners.

previewEnabled.description: Enable the Cloud Hypervisor v53.0 workload-execution preview. Requires container.containerRuntime: "cloud-hypervisor" and a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu x86_64 KVM runner.

mountPolicy.description: Host directory exposure policy. "workspace-only" is the secure default and exports the workspace plus only narrow gh-aw runtime directories when present. "workspace-and-tool-cache" additionally requires and mounts RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE or AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY read-only with host-enforced staging.

cloudHypervisorBinary.description: Absolute path to the Cloud Hypervisor v53.0 binary. Defaults to /usr/local/bin/cloud-hypervisor.

kernelPath.description: Absolute path to the trusted PCI-capable guest Linux kernel image.

rootfsPath.description: Absolute path to the trusted guest root filesystem image.

supervisorPath.description: Absolute path to the built AWF guest supervisor.

artifactManifestPath.description: Absolute path to the release-pinned Cloud Hypervisor artifact manifest.

artifactManifestBundlePath.description: Absolute path to the manifest GitHub artifact-attestation Sigstore bundle used for offline verification.

artifactReleaseTag.description: Expected AWF release tag recorded in the attested artifact manifest.

developmentAllowUnattestedArtifacts.description: Development-only legacy bypass. Also requires AWF_CLOUD_HYPERVISOR_DEVELOPMENT_ALLOW_UNATTESTED_ARTIFACTS=1 and complete sha256 pins.

apiTimeoutMs.description: Bounded timeout in milliseconds for Cloud Hypervisor API socket readiness and requests.

sha256.description: Development-only legacy SHA-256 pins. Release use derives all hashes from the verified artifact manifest.

chroot.description: Chroot execution overrides for split-filesystem ARC/DinD runners.

binariesSourcePath.description: Optional runner-side directory to overlay at /usr/local/bin inside chroot mode (for split-filesystem ARC/DinD runners).

identity.description: Identity values applied after chroot pivot to override HOME/USER defaults inside chroot mode.

home.description: Home directory path to export inside chroot mode (for example: "/tmp/gh-aw/home").

user.description: User/LOGNAME string to export inside chroot mode (for example: "runner").

uid.description: UID hint used for chroot identity synthesis and user switching.

gid.description: GID hint used for chroot identity synthesis and user switching.

dind.description: Bootstrap helpers for ARC/DinD split runner/daemon filesystems.

preStageDirs.description: When true and DinD is detected, AWF pre-creates the required /tmp/gh-aw directory tree inside the daemon-visible filesystem before compose startup.

workDir.description: Daemon-visible working directory for DinD pre-staging (default: "/tmp/gh-aw").

stagingImage.description: Container image used for short-lived DinD staging operations.

stageEngineBinary.description: Engine binary staging settings for split-filesystem DinD setups.

path.description: Runner-side path to the engine binary to stage (for example: "/usr/local/bin/copilot").

targetPath.description: Daemon filesystem destination path for the staged engine binary.

environment.description: Environment variable propagation into the agent container. Merge behavior is: AWF-reserved variables are set by AWF and are not overridden by envAll or envFile; if envAll is true, host environment variables are forwarded next; envFile is then applied only for variables not already present, so it does not override envAll; CLI -e/--env has highest precedence for user-supplied values and may override envAll/envFile. Reserved proxy variables may be overridden only via CLI -e/--env, while other AWF-reserved variables remain protected. Source credentials (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc.) are always excluded from the agent and held in the API proxy sidecar. See docs/awf-config-spec.md §8–9 for credential isolation rules.

envFile.description: Path to a .env file whose variables are injected into the agent container.

envAll.description: Forward all host environment variables into the agent container. Use with caution — may expose secrets.

excludeEnv.description: Environment variable names to exclude when envAll is true. Note: LLM API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc.) are always excluded from the agent by the API proxy sidecar regardless of this setting.

diagnosticLogs.description: Enable diagnostic logging (Squid access logs, iptables logs). Logs are written to the work directory.

proxyLogsDir.description: Directory path for Squid proxy access logs.

sessionStateDir.description: Directory path for agent session state (e.g. conversation history). Set to "/tmp/gh-aw/sandbox/agent/session-state" for Copilot agent runs.

requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests per minute.

requestsPerHour.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests per hour.

bytesPerMinute.description: Maximum number of bytes transferred per minute.

platform.description: GitHub platform deployment type. Explicitly declares the environment so AWF can apply correct auth behavior (e.g. token vs Bearer prefix) without relying on heuristic detection.

type.description: The GitHub deployment type. 'github.com' = GitHub.com (default), 'ghes' = GitHub Enterprise Server (on-premises), 'ghec' = GitHub Enterprise Cloud (*.ghe.com tenants), 'ghec-self-hosted' = GHEC with self-hosted runners.

runner.description: Runner topology configuration. Declares the runner deployment model so AWF can activate the correct split-filesystem, sysroot, and network isolation behavior.

topology.description: Runner deployment topology. 'standard' (default) = GitHub-hosted VM or self-hosted runner with local Docker. 'arc-dind' = ARC (Actions Runner Controller) with Docker-in-Docker sidecar, where the runner and Docker daemon have separate filesystems. When set to 'arc-dind', AWF enables sysroot staging (a sysroot-stage init container copies the build-tools image into a named volume mounted at /host:rw on the agent) and emits a warning when RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE points under /opt (which is typically invisible to the DinD daemon). Other ARC/DinD settings such as container.dockerHostPathPrefix, dind.preStageDirs, and network.isolation are configured explicitly through their own fields. See docs/arc-dind.md for a complete guide.

sysrootImage.description: Container image providing system-level build tools (gcc, make, libraries) for the agent's chroot base. Used as an init container that copies its filesystem into a named volume mounted at /host. Only used when runner.topology is 'arc-dind'. Defaults to 'ghcr.io/github/gh-aw-firewall/build-tools:<imageTag>'.

enclaves.description: Unified private-repository script and agent enclaves. Repositories shared across entries use one per-run information budget, and AWF exposes each entry only through its owned MCP server and the compiler-launched trusted mcpg gateway.

boundedAgents.description: Bounded-agent enclave configuration. When enabled, AWF stages an immutable seed per configured private repository, starts an offline broker, and exposes a fixed `bounded-agent` CLI plus a generated skill to the agent. Each invocation runs the configured native coding-agent engine inside a single-use enclave that joins only a dedicated `internal` bounded-agent Docker network whose sole other member is the AWF API proxy. Requires the API proxy and a supported configured engine/model route. See docs/awf-config-spec.md §15.

enabled.description: Enable bounded agents for this run. Requires a staging credential in GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN on the AWF host, an enabled API proxy, and a configured `engine`/`model` route. Default: false.

privateRepos.description: Repositories a bounded agent may reason about, each with a trusted confidentiality category that fixes its per-run information budget (`public` and `trusted` unmetered, `internal` 64 bits/run, `confidential` 8 bits/run, `sealed` 0 bits/run — never launches an enclave). Trusted enclave responses may contain free-form strings only inside strict structured schemas. Each `repo` must be a bare `owner/repo` slug — no scheme, host, credentials, path traversal, query string, fragment, or wildcard. Repository names must be unique case-insensitively. Bounded agents keep a ledger separate from bounded queries.

sensitivity.description: Confidentiality category, which fixes this repository's immutable per-run information budget. Cannot be increased by configuration.

runtime.description: Sandbox runtime backend used to execute the bounded-agent enclave, selected independently of the primary agent runtime. "docker" uses the daemon default runtime; "gvisor" requires the runsc OCI runtime; "sbx" is a fail-closed preview and is blocked until the installed sbx CLI proves the mandatory API-proxy-only network policy, read-only targeted mounts, unprivileged exec/workdir, and pids/disk/fsize/lifecycle controls this enclave requires. No backend ever falls back. Default: "docker".

engine.description: Native coding-agent runtime executed inside each single-use enclave. "copilot" is implemented with a dedicated pinned Copilot CLI image. Other accepted engine names fail closed until their dedicated images are implemented. The caller cannot choose or override this value.

profile.description: Legacy provider-loop compatibility field. Native engines select their fixed API-proxy route from `engine`; callers cannot override it. Default: "openai".

model.description: Model identifier sent on every enclave request. Required when enabled. A request can never choose or override it.

timeout.description: Maximum wall-clock time in seconds allowed for a single enclave invocation. Capped at 4740 so the 80-minute response bucket reserves its final minute for termination, validation, container removal, and workspace cleanup. Default: 120.

memoryLimit.description: Docker-style memory limit applied to the enclave (e.g. "512m"). Swap is disabled at the same value. Default: "512m".

cpuLimit.description: Fractional CPU limit applied to the enclave (Docker --cpus). Default: "1".

pidsLimit.description: Maximum number of processes/threads the enclave may create. Default: 128.

tmpfsLimit.description: Docker-style size limit for each of the enclave's writable tmpfs mounts (/tmp and the /agent work/result root). Default: "64m".

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of the enclave's dedicated result file. The broker reads back at most this many bytes and requires exactly one JSON value conforming to the declared finite schema. Default: 8192.

maxTaskBytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of the caller-supplied bounded task text. The task is byte-bounded input forwarded verbatim into the enclave prompt; it is never interpreted as configuration. Default: 4096.

maxInvocations.description: Maximum number of enclave responses permitted for the current AWF run. Every response — including a rejection — counts. Exhaustion returns the canonical error without launching an enclave. Default: 8.

maxModelRequests.description: Maximum number of model requests one enclave invocation may issue through the API proxy. Default: 8.

maxModelTokens.description: Maximum completion tokens requested per model call (max_tokens). Default: 1024.

pinnedImageReference.description: Literal, registry-qualified OCI image reference containing both a tag and an immutable SHA-256 digest: 'registry/repository:tag@sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>'.

basePath.description: Override the provider API base path.

authHeader.description: Override the auth header name used for API requests. For OpenAI, replaces 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' with '<authHeader>: <key>' (raw key, no Bearer prefix). For Anthropic, replaces 'x-api-key'. Not applicable to Copilot or Gemini.

providerHostOnlyTarget.description: API provider target override (host only; basePath not supported).

copilotTarget.description: Copilot target override (host only) plus non-sensitive BYOK supplemental headers.

extraHeaders.description: Additional non-sensitive headers to include on Copilot BYOK upstream requests. Values must be strings. Maps to AWF_BYOK_EXTRA_HEADERS in the sidecar.

extraBodyFields.description: Additional non-sensitive JSON body fields to include on Copilot BYOK upstream requests. Values must be strings. Maps to AWF_BYOK_EXTRA_BODY_FIELDS in the sidecar.

sessionId.description: Opt-in session identifier injected as the `x-session-id` request header and `session_id` body field on Copilot BYOK upstream requests. This is a GitHub Copilot API convention; strict OpenAI-compatible servers (e.g. Azure OpenAI) reject the unknown body field with HTTP 400, so the value must be set explicitly and is never auto-derived from `GITHUB_RUN_ID`. Maps to AWF_PROVIDER_SESSION_ID in the sidecar.
